message.content:
Here is a comprehensive, pixel-perfect specification for recreating the **SpeakFix AI** landing page:

---

## 1. OVERALL LAYOUT STRUCTURE

**Global Layout:**
- **Viewport:** Full-width, responsive container with max-width ~1400px for content
- **Background Pattern:** Subtle dark blue gradient with faint geometric mesh/grid lines (visible in dark sections)
- **Section Flow:**
  1. **Sticky Navbar** (fixed top, full-width)
  2. **Hero Section** (split layout: 40% text left / 60% visual right)
  3. **Features Section** (white background, 6-column grid)
  4. **How It Works** (dark background, split: steps left / dashboard mockup right)
  5. **CTA Footer** (dark gradient, centered content)

---

## 2. EXACT COLOR PALETTE

### Primary Colors (Dark Theme Sections)
| Element | Hex Code | Usage |
|---------|----------|-------|
| **Deep Navy Background** | `#0a0e27` | Main hero/how-it-works bg |
| **Dark Blue Surface** | `#111836` | Cards, sidebar, elevated surfaces |
| **Card Background** | `#1a2240` | Chat bubbles, feature cards in dark mode |
| **Border/Subtle** | `#253054` | Dividers, card borders |

### Accent Colors
| Element | Hex Code | Usage |
|---------|----------|-------|
| **Primary Blue** | `#4f6ef7` | Buttons, active states, primary CTA |
| **Bright Blue Glow** | `#6b8cff` | Hover states, glowing effects |
| **Cyan/Teal** | `#00d4ff` | Secondary accents, microphone glow |
| **Success Green** | `#10b981` | Status indicators, "Listening" dot |
| **Warning Orange** | `#f59e0b` | Priority detection icon |
| **Purple** | `#8b5cf6` | Track tickets icon |
| **Text White** | `#ffffff` | Headlines |
| **Text Gray** | `#94a3b8` | Body text, descriptions |
| **Text Muted** | `#64748b` | Secondary text, timestamps |

### Light Theme (Features Section)
- **Background:** `#ffffff`
- **Text Primary:** `#0f172a`
- **Text Secondary:** `#475569`
- **Icon Backgrounds:** Light tints of accent colors (opacity 0.1)

---

## 3. TYPOGRAPHY SPECIFICATIONS

**Font Family:** Inter (or SF Pro Display / -apple-system fallback)
- **Headlines:** Font-weight 700-800 (ExtraBold)
- **Subheadlines:** Font-weight 400-500 (Regular-Medium)
- **Body:** Font-weight 400 (Regular), size 16px, line-height 1.6
- **Small/Captions:** Font-size 14px, weight 500, color muted gray
- **Nav Items:** Font-size 15px, weight 500, letter-spacing -0.01em

**Specific Text Treatments:**
- **Hero "Fix it."**: 
  - Color: `#4f6ef7` (Primary Blue) OR gradient from `#4f6ef7` to `#6b8cff`
  - Size: ~64px (desktop), weight 800
- **"Report it. Speak it."**: 
  - Color: White (`#ffffff`)
  - Size: ~64px, weight 700
- **Badge Text ("VOICE-POWERED...")**: 
  - Uppercase, tracking 0.1em, size 12px, color `#6b8cff`, weight 600
- **Button Text**: 
  - Weight 600, size 15px, letter-spacing 0.02em

---

## 4. UI ELEMENTS SPECIFICATION

### A. Navigation Bar
- **Height:** 72px
- **Background:** Transparent with backdrop-blur (glassmorphism) when scrolled, or solid `#0a0e27`
- **Logo:** 
  - Icon: Microphone inside circle (blue gradient `#4f6ef7` to `#6b8cff`)
  - Text: "SpeakFix" (White, bold) + "AI" (Blue, lighter weight)
- **Nav Links:** Home (active with bottom border 2px blue), Features, How It Works, About
- **Right Actions:**
  - **Log In Button:** Outlined, border `#334155`, text white, rounded-full, px-6 py-2
  - **Sign Up Button:** Filled `#4f6ef7`, text white, rounded-full, px-6 py-2, hover glow effect

### B. Hero Buttons
- **Primary ("Get Started →"):**
  - Background: Linear gradient 135deg, `#4f6ef7` to `#6366f1`
  - Padding: 14px 32px
  - Border-radius: 9999px (pill)
  - Shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.4)
  - Icon: Arrow right (→) with margin-left 8px
- **Secondary ("Sign In"):**
  - Background: Transparent
  - Border: 1px solid `#334155`
  - Same padding/radius as primary
  - Hover: Border lightens to `#475569`

### C. Chat Interface Mockup (Hero Right Side)
- **Container:** Rounded-2xl (16px), background `#111836`, border 1px `#253054`, shadow-xl
- **Header:** 
  - "Live Conversation" label with green pulsing dot (animation: pulse 2s infinite)
  - "Listening..." status text in green
- **Chat Bubbles:**
  - **User bubbles:** Darker bg `#1e293b`, rounded-2xl, left-aligned avatar (user icon circle)
  - **AI bubbles:** Slightly lighter `#253352`, rounded-2xl, left-aligned avatar (blue waveform icon)
  - **Typography:** 14px, line-height 1.5, color `#e2e8f0`
- **Microphone Button (Floating):**
  - Position: Absolute, bottom center of chat mockup, overlapping edge
  - Size: 80px diameter
  - Background: Radial gradient (center white/blue to transparent)
  - Border: 3px solid `#4f6ef7`
  - Icon: Microphone (white, 32px)
  - **Glow Effect:** Box-shadow 0 0 30px rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.6), 0 0 60px rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.3)
  - **Animation:** Pulse ring expanding outward (CSS keyframes)

### D. Feature Cards (Light Section)
- **Layout:** CSS Grid, 6 columns, gap 24px
- **Card Structure:**
  - **Icon Container:** 64x64px, rounded-2xl, background tinted (10% opacity of brand color)
    - Natural Voice: Light blue bg (`#eff6ff`), Mic icon (`#3b82f6`)
    - Smart Understanding: Light purple bg (`#f5f3ff`), Brain icon (`#8b5cf6`)
    - Auto Ticket: Light green bg (`#ecfdf5`), Ticket icon (`#10b981`)
    - Priority: Light orange bg (`#fffbeb`), Warning icon (`#f59e0b`)
    - Categorization: Light indigo bg (`#eef2ff`), Grid icon (`#6366f1`)
    - Track: Light purple bg (`#faf5ff`), Chart icon (`#a855f7`)
  - **Title:** 18px, font-weight 600, color `#0f172a`, margin-top 16px
  - **Description:** 14px, color `#64748b`, line-height 1.6, margin-top 8px

### E. How It Works Steps
- **Numbering:** Circular badges, 40px diameter, background `#1e293b`, border 1px `#334155`
  - Number: White, 18px, bold
  - Connector lines between steps: Dashed or dotted, color `#334155`, horizontal
- **Step Icons:** Inside circular dark backgrounds (similar to feature icons but darker theme)
  - 1. Mic icon (blue)
  - 2. Brain icon (purple)
  - 3. Chat bubble (cyan)
  - 4. Ticket/document (gray-blue)
  - 5. Checkmark circle (green)
- **Step Titles:** 20px, bold, white, margin-top 12px
- **Step Descriptions:** 14px, `#94a3b8`, max-width 200px

### F. Dashboard Mockup (How It Works Right Side)
- **Container:** Rounded-xl, overflow-hidden, border `#334155`, shadow-2xl
- **Structure:**
  - **Left Sidebar (Dark):** Width 200px, background `#0f172a`
    - Logo at top: "SpeakFix AI" small
    - Nav items: Dashboard, Report Issue (active, blue bg), My Tickets, Profile, Logout
    - Each item: Icon + text, 14px, padding 12px 16px
  - **Main Content (White/Light):**
    - Header: "Good morning, Hiomla" + User avatar dropdown
    - Central Element: Large microphone button (similar to hero but smaller, 120px), "Tap to speak" caption below
    - Right Panel: "Recent Tickets" list
      - Ticket items: Red/orange/green status dots, Title, Room number, Time, Priority badge (High/Medium/Low colored pills)

---

## 5. EXACT TEXT CONTENT

**Navbar:**
- Home | Features | How It Works | About | [Log In] [Sign Up]

**Hero:**
- **Badge:** VOICE-POWERED MAINTENANCE REPORTING
- **H1:** Report it. Speak it. Fix it.
- **Subhead:** SpeakFix AI is a voice-powered maintenance and incident reporting agent. Simply tell us the issue, and our AI will understand, ask follow-up questions, and create a structured ticket — no forms, no hassle.
- **Buttons:** [Get Started →] [Sign In]
- **Trust Badges:** ✓ Fast • Simple • Secure

**Chat Content (visible):**
- *User:* The projector in Room 204 keeps switching off, and we have a lecture there tomorrow.
- *AI:* Got it. Is the projector completely unusable right now?
- *User:* Yes, it doesn't turn on at all.
- *AI:* I've created a maintenance ticket. It's a high-priority IT/AV issue for Room 204. Your ticket number is SF-0012.

**Features Section:**
- **H2:** Key Features
- **Subhead:** Everything you need for faster, smarter maintenance reporting.
- **Cards:**
  1. **Natural Voice Interaction** - Report issues by simply speaking.
  2. **Smart Understanding** - Our AI understands your issue and asks follow-ups if needed.
  3. **Automatic Ticket Generation** - Turns your conversation into a structured ticket.
  4. **Priority Detection** - Identifies urgency and classifies the issue.
  5. **Categorization** - IT/AV, Electrical, Plumbing, Facilities, Security and more.
  6. **Track Your Tickets** - View and manage your submitted reports.

**How It Works:**
- **H2:** How It Works
- **Subhead:** From your voice to a solution — in just a few steps.
- **Steps:**
  1. **Speak** - Tell us what's wrong using your voice.
  2. **Understand** - Our AI listens and understands the issue.
  3. **Follow Up** - We ask questions if anything is missing.
  4. **Create Ticket** - A structured ticket is created automatically.
  5. **Confirm** - You'll get a voice and text confirmation.

**CTA Section:**
- **Headline:** Ready to make maintenance reporting easier?
- **Subhead:** Join SpeakFix AI today and experience the future of voice-powered support.
- **Buttons:** [Get Started →] [Learn More]

---

## 6. VISUAL EFFECTS & DECORATIVE ELEMENTS

### Gradients
- **Hero Background:** Radial gradient from `#1e3a8a` (top-right) to `#0a0e27` (bottom-left), opacity 0.4
- **Microphone Glow:** Radial gradient circle, `rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.3)` expanding
- **Button Gradient:** Linear 135deg, `#4f6ef7` → `#6366f1`
- **Text Gradient (optional):** "Fix it." could use `-webkit-background-clip: text` with blue gradient

### Shadows
- **Card Shadows:** `0 20px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)` for dark mode cards
- **Button Shadows:** `0 4px 14px rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.4)`
- **Floating Elements:** `0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)`

### Glows
- **Active Microphone:** `box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(79, 110, 247, 0.6)`
- **Chat Input Area:** Subtle blue inner glow

### Decorative Shapes
- **Background Mesh:** SVG pattern of intersecting lines (opacity 0.03, color white) visible in dark sections
- **Floating Particles:** Optional subtle animated dots or light orbs in hero background
- **Glassmorphism:** Navbar and some cards use `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` with `background: rgba(10, 14, 39, 0.8)`

---

## 7. LAYOUT POSITIONING DETAILS

**Hero Section:**
- **Container:** Max-width 1280px, mx-auto, padding-x 24px
- **Left Column (Text):** 
  - Width: 45%
  - Padding-top: 60px (to align visually with right side image)
  - Text alignment: Left
  - Badge: Margin-bottom 24px
  - H1: Margin-bottom 24px, max-width 500px
  - Subhead: Margin-bottom 32px, max-width 480px, color `#94a3b8`
  - Buttons: Flex row, gap 16px, margin-bottom 24px
  - Trust badges: Flex row, gap 16px, font-size 14px, color `#64748b`
  
- **Right Column (Visual):**
  - Width: 55%
  - Position: Relative
  - **Character Illustration:** Positioned absolute/left, z-index 10, overlaps chat window slightly from left side
  - **Chat Window:** Positioned relative/right, z-index 20, transform: rotateY(-2deg) slight perspective for 3D effect
  - **Microphone Button:** Absolute positioning, bottom -20px, left 50%, translateX(-50%), z-index 30

**Features Section:**
- Padding: 100px 24px
- Centered text header (max-width 600px, mx-auto, text-center)
- Grid: `grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr)`, gap 24px (or responsive: 2 cols mobile, 3 cols tablet, 6 cols desktop)

**How It Works:**
- Background: Dark navy (`#0a0e27`) with subtle gradient overlay
- Padding: 80px 24px
- **Left Side (Steps):** Width 45%, flex column, justify-center
- **Right Side (Dashboard):** Width 55%, position relative
  - Dashboard image: Slight rotation (2deg), shadow huge, rounded-xl overflow-hidden
  - Contains realistic UI screenshot/mockup

**CTA Section:**
- Background: Deep dark (`#050816`) to navy gradient
- Padding: 80px 24px
- Text-align: center
- Max-width: 600px for text, mx-auto
- Buttons centered, gap 16px

---

## 8. IMAGES/ILLUSTRATIONS SPECIFICATIONS

### Main Character (Hero)
- **Style:** Anime/manga style digital illustration
- **Subject:** Young woman, dark hair (black/dark blue), blue eyes
- **Clothing:** Black hoodie/jacket with high collar, subtle tech/wireless earpiece visible
- **Pose:** 3/4 view facing camera, slight head tilt, friendly expression
- **Lighting:** Rim lighting with blue/cyan glow from behind (matching brand colors), creating halo effect
- **Positioning:** Overlaps the chat interface from the left side, appears to be "presenting" the interface
- **Quality:** High resolution, transparent PNG or composited with blend mode (screen/lighten) for glow effects

### Dashboard Mockup (How It Works)
- **Style:** Flat UI design, realistic application interface
- **Components:**
  - Dark sidebar with navigation icons (outline style)
  - Main content area with clean white background
  - "Tap to speak" central interface with large mic button
  - Ticket list with status indicators (colored dots: red for critical, orange for medium, green for low)
  - User profile dropdown in top-right
- **Details:** 
  - Shows username "Hiomla Haldorson"
  - Sample ticket data: "SF-0012", "Projector not working", "Room 204", "Leaking tap", etc.
  - Timestamps: "2 hours ago", "5 hours ago"
  - Priority tags: "High" (red bg), "Medium" (orange), "Low" (green)

### Icons (All Sections)
- **Style:** Phosphor Icons or Heroicons (outline style, stroke width 1.5-2px)
- **Sizes:** 
  - Feature icons: 32px
  - Step icons: 24px
  - Nav icons: 20px
  - Button icons: 18px
- **Colors:** Match their respective category colors (as specified in section 4D)

---

## ADDITIONAL DEVELOPER NOTES

**Responsive Breakpoints:**
- **Mobile (<768px):** Single column layout, hero stacks (image below text), features grid becomes 2 columns then 1, dashboard mockup becomes full width
- **Tablet (768-1024px):** Hero becomes stacked or smaller split, features 3 columns
- **Desktop (>1024px):** Full specifications as above

**Animations to Implement:**
1. **Microphone Pulse:** CSS `@keyframes pulse` scaling from 1 to 1.1, opacity glow
2. **Typing Indicator:** Three bouncing dots in chat when "AI is typing"
3. **Fade In On Scroll:** Intersection Observer for sections appearing
4. **Hover States:** Buttons lift up (translateY -2px), cards get brighter borders

**Accessibility:**
- Ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG AA (white on dark blue passes, gray text on dark needs checking)
- Focus rings on all interactive elements (blue outline, 2px offset)
- Alt text for character illustration and dashboard mockup

This specification should allow a developer to recreate the design with pixel-perfect fidelity using HTML/Tailwind CSS and minimal custom CSS for the complex gradients and animations.
